_comment: Severity-gate thresholds per profile. A value of -1 means unlimited (never fails on that severity). The gate fails (exit 1) when the observed count for a severity exceeds its max. Override per-run with --max-<sev> flags or PENTEST_GATE_MAX_<SEV> env vars.

appsec._note: Shift-left PR gate. Starts lenient (fail on critical only) so adoption is not blocked by an initial backlog; tighten max_high to 0 once the baseline is clean.
